tools.name: snapshot_info
tools.description: Returns the snapshot date and source behind the other tools, and which fields are kept or dropped. Example output: {"snapshot_at":"2026-10-31T00:00:00Z","source":"Official MCP Registry"}. No arguments. Good for 'Which day do these numbers describe and where do they come from?'.
